basis: F-61: third-party services are declared in the version manifest. Draft (IDEA-042 item 8); final at the Oct 26 freeze.

services.purpose: market data, executable quotes, approve/swap transaction building, token balances and history
services.scope: the five eligible bStocks and USDT/BNB on BNB Smart Chain (F-91, F-93)

services.purpose: official per-round decision logs (input, cot, output, orders)
services.scope: one log per decision round, signed with the wallet's AI_SEEDS_SECRET (F-99..F-101)

services.provider: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (data.sec.gov, www.sec.gov/Archives)
services.purpose: filings for the evidence assessor (8-K and periodic reports of the eligible issuers)
services.scope: submissions JSON and filing archives, contact User-Agent (LARP_SEC_USER_AGENT)

services.provider: SEC press, Federal Register (two feeds), DOJ press, European Commission press
services.purpose: official event flags for the evidence state (SHADOW_ONLY records)
services.scope: the sources enabled in config/sources/sources.v1.json; all others disabled
services.terms_ref: config/sources/sources.v1.json (rights and terms per source); IDEA-031; GAP-23/24

services.purpose: Primary evidence assessment in opt-in AIandRouting.v3; deterministic verification of every claim; no trade authority (D-11)
services.scope: Unsigned v3 trial approved in PR168 / PC-REL05; complete model I/O and reasoning summaries retained. Host/provider qualification pending; signed/scored adoption remains separate.
services.fallback: Independent AIand Kimi K3 high, then GLM-5.3 high; required review failures grant no authority and verified disagreement abstains. Deterministic shadow remains the default until explicit prepared routing.

services.provider: AIand inference API (api.aiand.com): moonshotai/kimi-k3 / high, then zai-org/glm-5.3 / high
services.purpose: Independent evidence review and fallback for OpenAI-primary v3; reviewers receive original evidence
services.scope: Opt-in unsigned v3 trial only; account funding/identity/network/rights checks pending. No low-effort routine call in v3; legacy v1/v2 configurations retain their own policies.

services.provider: Development balance reads: BNB Chain public primary, NodeReal public backup (Isaac, 2026-10-17; IDEA-055 RPC-Q01 D1); execution provider qualification remains separate
services.purpose: finalized-block wallet balance reads for the chain-balance check (IDEA-055) and the execution service's chain reads and receipts
services.scope: read-only allowlisted methods (larp/execution_live/chain.py); eth_call only for decimals() and balanceOf(wallet) on the six pinned contracts
services.terms_ref: #92; docs/build/RPC_QUALIFICATION.md; IDEA-055 RPC-Q01 D1; docs/build/architecture-deployment.md Approved network destinations (IDEA-062)
services.fallback: with no provider configured, a dev or live start is refused (exit 4)

services.provider: Amazon Web Services (account and region pending, B9)
services.purpose: runtime hosts, RDS PostgreSQL, S3 Object Lock archive and hourly anchors, KMS, CloudWatch alarms
services.scope: deploy/aws Terraform; retention at least to 2026-12-31 (IDEA-036)
